scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s east-grove bark-texture station able to offer its planned hands-on rubbing board.
Emerging Need: The station moves from tentative idea to confirmed public activity while the required BRK-4 city board remains absent from the supply path.
Decision Context: Early planning alone would not justify reserving interpretation materials; a stored checkout procedure identifies the required asset, custodian, no-substitute rule, location details, and queue cutoff.
Consequence: Timely coordination preserves the hands-on station without spending or overpromising; after the kit queue closes, the program can proceed only with poster discussion.

parameter.title: Draft prep: East Grove bark-texture station
parameter.description: Tentative volunteer planning block for a possible bark-texture comparison table during Autumn Nature Morning; hands-on materials are not yet confirmed.
parameter.location: Brindlewood Park east grove picnic loop

parameter.subject: Autumn Nature Morning listing draft includes bark station
parameter.body: The public listing draft now includes a Tree Bark Up Close stop in the east grove for Saturday, pending ordinary supply-kit notes. The current supply outline still shows poster sheets, pencils, and a tablecloth only.

parameter.content: Sign-up notes now show 12 family groups expecting the bark-texture table. My tote list has posters, crayons, pencils, and the tablecloth, but no BRK-4 board or any other rubbing board, and I’m leaving the old camp bark pieces out.

parameter.title: Draft prep: East Grove bark-texture station
parameter.description: Confirmed staffed public hands-on bark-rubbing station for Autumn Nature Morning, using the east grove picnic-loop table beside the oak sign; the selected rubbing activity requires its city board.
parameter.location: Brindlewood Park east grove picnic loop, table beside the oak sign

parameter.subject: Weekend interpretation kit queue is closed
parameter.body: The interpretation kit queue locked at 14:00 for this weekend. The finalized east-grove station manifest lists poster sheets, pencils, crayons, and a tablecloth; no BRK-4 board request was on file before the lock.
